nodes.label: Namida public orchestration reference
nodes.rationale: Use public app responsibilities as reference without copying unavailable private youtipie implementation or treating inferred protocol details as requirements.

nodes.label: Native decoder and output evidence
nodes.rationale: Decoded/output operation and non-silent cached signals are demonstrated, while physical speaker recording is not claimed.

nodes.label: TubeDesk versioned verification evidence
nodes.rationale: The document records earlier-release checks separately from the current renamed source and states what each check establishes.

nodes.label: Verified native audio readiness
nodes.rationale: Video restart alone does not establish sound. Readiness also requires selected expected audio, decoder parameters and active output while preserving intentional mute/volume.

nodes.label: Stable comment-anchor pagination
nodes.rationale: The CLI exposes no reusable provider continuation, so bounded prefix re-extraction locates a stable final-comment ID; missing anchors request refresh and UI deduplicates shifting results.

nodes.label: Disposable cache boundary
nodes.rationale: Internal cache can be evicted and full-source caching consumes additional bandwidth; explicit Downloads provide intentional permanent storage.

nodes.label: Pinned cache file leases
nodes.rationale: Clearing retires entries immediately but delays byte deletion until the native player closes pinned files; eviction targets older unpinned entries.

nodes.label: Current-load stale-work guard
nodes.rationale: New load identities prevent old extraction, native entry events and recovery attempts from committing to a newer selection.

nodes.label: Local-first source selection
nodes.rationale: Try completed downloads, then validated internal components, then online extraction; explicit quality changes may bypass a lower-quality local source.

nodes.label: FFprobe publication gate
nodes.rationale: Partial files cannot become reusable offline entries until expected tracks and complete duration are validated.

nodes.label: Session-generation invalidation
nodes.rationale: Account changes invalidate account media and private metadata; comment cursors bind to session generation as well as video and sort.

nodes.label: Stable media identity
nodes.rationale: Reusable local media must survive expiring extraction URLs; persisted indexes omit signed URLs, headers and cookies.

nodes.label: Explicit verification limits
nodes.rationale: Historical tests do not certify every DPI, disk-full, expiry, codec or provider-policy case; installer compilation is distinguished from installation.

nodes.label: Session browse cache
nodes.rationale: Retain loaded metadata and scroll positions across navigation; explicit reload requests freshness, and account changes invalidate incompatible views.

nodes.label: Scroll-triggered pagination
nodes.rationale: Fetch another page near the list end rather than loading an entire playlist when playback starts.

nodes.label: Local playback history
nodes.rationale: Keep guest/account local positions separate from YouTube remote watch history; playback does not intentionally report remote progress.

nodes.label: Isolated account WebView
nodes.rationale: Keep Google sign-in in a dedicated profile, avoid external-browser cookie import, and deny privileged app capabilities to remote pages.

nodes.label: Stable internal app identifier
nodes.rationale: Keep app.tubedesk.desktop so existing sign-in, settings, cache and local history use the same data location after the rename.
